notes.title: "Dark Gravity" is available now - Full Version !
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=0HzdMJEzxcg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Grab your controller, fellow gamers! Today, we're announcing the arrival of an epic moment we've all been waiting for - the premiere of a game that will change the rules of the game! Welcome to the world of "Dark Gravity," where action is at your fingertips, and gameplay is pure magic. [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205130/Dark_Gravity/

[h3][b]What's "Dark Gravity" all about?[/b][/h3]

Dark Gravity" is a fast-paced, low poly vertical shoot'em up game that features non-linear campaign mode with lots of enemies and bosses. Craft new weapons, upgrade your fighter and build an ultimate aerial war machine!

[h3][b]Get ready for the adventure![/b][/h3]

If you're up for the challenge, there's nothing left to do but head to the "Dark Gravity" page on Steam and immerse yourself in this fascinating journey. Great possibilities, mysteries, and unpredictable moments await you ! Join other gamers and let yourself be drawn into the dark magnetism of "Dark Gravity ".

[h3][b]Plan your journey now![/b][/h3]

Wishing you an exciting gameplay and unforgettable moments in the world of "Dark Gravity!"

Have fun!
Dark Gravity Team

notes.title: Patch 0.1 Released!
notes.notes:
Dear Pilots,

Thank you all for participating in our Prologue. We are overwhelmed by positive feedback received by you, we also saw some of the complaints you had, so we worked hard on implementing fixes.

Today we are releasing Patch 0.1, which focuses on fixing some of the issues you guys encountered:

[list]
[*] Key Mappings for flying sideways were inverted
[*] Key Mappings were not saved after restarting the game
[/list]


Hope you will be still enjoying our game and don't forget to add it to your wishlist, so you are informed on any news regarding the game.

See you soon.
